============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// ============================================================================\n\nval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\nbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n\n        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n        }\n        return false;\n    });\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\nval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (local rows x N, row-major)\n    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (local rows x N, row-major)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    // MPI row distribution: this rank owns rows [rowStart, rowStart + rowCount)\n    size_t rowStart;\n    size_t rowCount;\n    std::vector<int> rowCounts;     // Rows owned by each rank\n    std::vector<int> rowDispls;     // First row of each rank\n\n    // Index into local (distributed) row-major matrices kij/tau\n    size_t idxLocal2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return (i - rowStart) * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    // Block distribution of triangle rows across MPI state.rowDispls.resize(mpiSize);\n    for (int r = 0; r < mpiSize; ++r) {\n        state.rowDispls[r] = static_cast<int>(rowStartOf(state.numTriangles, r));\n        state.rowCounts[r] = static_cast<int>(rowStartOf(state.numTriangles, r + 1)) - state.rowDispls[r];\n    }\n\n    if (mpiRank == 0) printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    if (mpiRank == 0) printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Initialize matrices (kij/tau hold only this rank's rows)\n    state.kij.resize(state.rowCount * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    if (mpiRank == 0) printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n\n    // Advance the RNG to the exact stream position the sequential code would\n    // have reached at this rank's first row. computeKij draws 4 randoms per\n    // ray (2 points x 2 coords) for every pair that passes the normal cull,\n    // and none for culled pairs, so the offset is exactly computable.\n    unsigned long long (size_t i = state.rowStart; i < state.rowStart + state.rowCount; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.kij[state.idxLocal2d(i, j)] = computeKij(\n                i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n        }\n        if (mpiRank == 0 && ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == state.rowStart + state.rowCount)) {\n            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles (rank 0)\\n\", i + 1, state.rowStart + state.rowCount);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    if (mpiRank == 0) printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t i = state.rowStart; i < state.rowStart + state.rowCount; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.tau[state.idxLocal2d(i, j)] = computeTau(\n                state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    if (mpiRank == 0) printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n        for (size_t i = state.rowStart; i < state.rowStart + state.rowCount; ++i) {\n            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n\n &state.radB[state.idxTN(t, 0)],\n                       state.rowCounts.data(), state.rowDispls.data(),\n                       MPI_FLOAT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (mpiRank == 0 && ((t + 1) % 10 ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    if (mpiRank == 0) printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t i = state.rowStart; i < state.rowStart + state.rowCount; ++i) {\n        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n        int bestT = 0;\n\n        // Discrete ============================================================================\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n    if (mpiRank == 0) printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // The `kij` and `tau` matrices — the O(N²) memory — are now stored only for each rank's local rows, so memory scales down with the number of ranks. Mesh, octree, and the small T×N radiosity arrays are replicated.\n- **Form factors** (the dominant cost, Monte Carlo raytracing per pair): each rank computes only its rows. To keep results bitwise-identical to the sequential code, each rank fast-forwards the shared `mt19937(42)` stream with `discard()` to the exact position the sequential loop would have reached at its first row. That offset is exactly computable because `computeKij` draws exactly 64 randoms per pair unless the pair is culled by the normal test (which draws none), and one `uniform_real_distribution<float>` call consumes exactly one engine step (verified with a runtime test). The offset count is a cheap O(N²) pass of dot products.\n- **Wave propagation**: each timestep, ranks compute their rows of `radB[t]` using only their local `kij`/`tau` rows, then an in-place `MPI_Allgatherv` (N floats) replicates the row so all ranks have the history needed for later timesteps. This is the only recurring communication.\n- **Distance cross-correlation** (O(N·T²)): distributed by rows, followed by one `MPI_Allgatherv` of the distance vector.\n- **Validation** works on all ranks (data is replicated where needed); the non-zero `kij` count uses `MPI_Allreduce` since that matrix is distributed. All console output, the hash, and `-o` result printing come from rank 0 only. `MPI_Barrier` brackets each timed phase so the reported times are meaningful.\n\n`CMakeLists.txt` adds `find_package(MPI REQUIRED COMPONENTS CXX)` and links `MPI::MPI_CXX` — no new dependencies beyond MPI itself, and the build is warning-free.
